page_title: PAU 3-3 DOR | St. Pauli v Dortmund 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+3' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 3 Goal! Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is teed up on the edge of the box by Manolis Saliakas, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:3.
87' Here comes a substitution. James Sands is given a rest as he is replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
87' Here is a change. Pascal Gross is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
86' 2 - 3 Goal! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Gregor Kobel.
86' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' That will be the end of the match for Filippo Mane (Dortmund), who is shown a red card!
84' It’s a PENALTY to St. Pauli after the VAR review!
84' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
84' Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

82' A pass into the box finds Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gregor Kobel denies him. Now St. Pauli have a corner.
82' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. Dortmund earn a corner.
77' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Adam Dzwigala will be replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arkadiusz Pyrka leaves the pitch and Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) comes on.
74' 1 - 3 Goal! Pascal Gross tees up Julian Brandt (Dortmund) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:3.
73' Dortmund are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
71' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The attendance is 29546.
68' A substitution has been made. Andreas Hountondji goes off and Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) comes on.

67' 1 - 2 Stunning strike! Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) latches on to a precise through ball from Felix Nmecha before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:2.

66' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Gregor Kobel has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
65' The referee shows a yellow card to Yan Couto (Dortmund). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
64' Yan Couto (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to St. Pauli.
63' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.
62' A player from St. Pauli pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Dortmund, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
62' The St. Pauli players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
61' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to St. Pauli.
59' Nice passing game by St. Pauli. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
53' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

50' 1 - 1 It's in! Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the bottom left corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Danel Sinani. 1:1.
48' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

48' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Nikola Vasilj makes a brilliant save! Dortmund have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) will not participate anymore and Felix Nmecha is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is replaced by Julian Brandt.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' The corner from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is intercepted by Gregor Kobel.
45+3' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+2' Looks like Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' PENALTY APPEAL after Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
44' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
43' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

39' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the left post. Nikola Vasilj anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
38' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
38' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.

38' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) brings an opponent down and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game. PENALTY to Dortmund! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
36' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcel Sabitzer plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) times his jump perfectly and sends a header inside the right post from close in. 0:1.
33' Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game. One of the players from St. Pauli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Dortmund.
33' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.

31' Dortmund players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
28' St. Pauli are awarded the free kick. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
27' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is adjudged offside.
26' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
25' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

24' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Nikola Vasilj pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
23' Yan Couto (Dortmund) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
22' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) is given a yellow card.
21' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) is flagged for offside.
19' A quickly taken corner by St. Pauli.

18' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Gregor Kobel has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
17' The foul by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) was seen by Matthias Jollenbeck who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

15' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
14' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli have a free kick.
13' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is able to continue to play.
12' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
11' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle as Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
10' That was close by Louis Oppie (St. Pauli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
10' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' A player from Dortmund commits a rough challenge. Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. St. Pauli will take a free kick.
7' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
5' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Dortmund.
4' Great teamplay by St. Pauli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St. Pauli.
2' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matthias Jollenbeck saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Dortmund in a dangerous position.
1' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! St. Pauli will take the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will supervise the game today.
